verdict.rationale: Unit is an API-first platform: teams build on it through APIs, and it offers an OpenAPI spec, Postman collections, and a sandbox that fully replicates production, with simulation endpoints for testing integrations end-to-end. That supports programmatic, headless automation and automated testing, but nothing explicitly documents CI usage. missing for 10: explicit CI/CD integration guidance, documented machine credentials or service tokens for unattended runs, a CLI or headless tooling beyond raw API and Postman, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: Companies can build directly on the Unit Platform using APIs and components

Unit's Sandbox environment is a full replica of the production environment — all standard API endpoints work exactly the same way. Use it to build and test your integration end-to-end before going live.
An OpenAPI 3.0 specification for the Unit API is available here
